name: Forced displacement
summary: Thousands more flee Darfur and Kordofan in November; no UN-confirmed new event over 500,000 a month
state: A UN agency said more than 5,200 people were displaced from North and South Darfur in three days (Anadolu, 12 Nov), and a Kordofan monitor said about 3,000 fled strikes around Abu Qalb in West Kordofan in the week to 21 Nov (Rio Times). IOM said on 1 Nov that more than 300,000 people had fled fighting in western Yemen over two months (Khaleej Times). None reaches 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: No direct effect expected for most readers. Displacement in Sudan and Yemen adds to pressure on aid budgets and neighbouring countries.
rubric_hit: No new event displacing > 500,000 in a month = Normal
